observations.text: Official rule: activating JOT-29 converts RAV-31 into its active form.
When active RAV-31 is present, it produces GOL-56.
When GOL-56 encounters VOR-32, the validated terminal code becomes MUR-19.
Official revision: for the chain involving GOL-56 and VOR-32, the accepted terminal code is MUR-19; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with VOR-32 is JOT-63.
Official rule: activating BIR-35 converts MUR-99 into its active form.
When active MUR-99 is present, it produces FEN-62.
When FEN-62 encounters ZIR-66, the validated terminal code becomes ZUM-11.
Official revision: for the chain involving FEN-62 and ZIR-66, the accepted terminal code is ZUM-11; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with ZIR-66 is LOQ-42.
Official rule: activating BEX-30 converts NIX-86 into its active form.
When active NIX-86 is present, it produces XAN-51.
When XAN-51 encounters JOT-50, the validated terminal code becomes MUR-82.
Official revision: for the chain involving XAN-51 and JOT-50, the accepted terminal code is MUR-82; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with JOT-50 is LOQ-60.
